recordCount.description: Canonical rows, including replay and candidate evidence; not a dispatch count.

associatedTurnGaps.description: Gaps among associated records; unassigned membership is separately reported below.

path.description: Resolved historical local target; never sent by share-v1.

associatedUseCount.description: Exact count in the positively associated canonical set; coverage explains local gaps.

useCount.description: Complete turn count is unavailable when association or unassigned-membership evidence has gaps.

intersectionMasksMs.description: Masks 0..15: command bit 1, compaction bit 2, reasoning bit 4, MCP bit 8.

identifiedIntervalCount.description:
Majority/list denominator: unique identified lifecycle intervals, including
excluded conflicts; records without identity are counted only in coverage.

unlocatedIntervalCount.description:
Unique identified intervals that cannot be placed; missing-identity records
remain in coverage and are not guessed to be separate intervals.

maximumIncrease.description: Zero means comparable stages had no positive first-to-last change; null means no comparison.

OutcomeStatistics.description: Counts in the captured subset, rather than inferred complete-turn totals.

identityGapRecords.description: Missing-identity observations use physical-record units, unlike canonical group counts.

QueryFreshness.description: Internal selector observation; not a request option or source capability.

RepeatEvidencePage.description: Local source-record proofs. Sharing contains no repeat locators or aliases.

pageCount.description: Sum of page locators over intervals, after merging each interval's same-page refs.

IntervalPage.description: Local navigation only: the sharing DTO has no evidence index or cursor type.
